career_ladder.note: Management Trainees (Technical) in Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) undergo 1 year of structured training in Executive Grade E-1 across steel plants (Bhilai, Bokaro, Rourkela, Durgapur, IISCO Burnpur, Salem, Alloy Steels Plant) and corporate units. Upon successful completion of training, they are regularized as Assistant Manager in Grade E-1 and progress through executive management cadres per the SAIL Executive Promotion Policy.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Management Trainees (Technical) in SAIL is conducted through Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) scores followed by Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) for shortlisted candidates (1:3 ratio category-wise and discipline-wise). Final merit is determined with 75% weightage to normalized GATE score, 10% weightage to Group Discussion, and 15% weightage to Personal Interview.

financial_package.note: Compensation is governed by DPE 3rd Pay Revision Committee (PRC) guidelines for Maharatna CPSEs. During the one-year training period, MTTs receive starting basic pay of ₹50,000 in Grade E-1 (scale ₹50,000–₹1,60,000). On regular absorption as Assistant Manager, basic pay remains ₹50,000 with standard annual increments. Includes mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, cafeteria approach allowances @ 35% of basic pay, HRA (9% to 27%) or steel plant township accommodation, performance-related pay (PRP), and SAIL mediclaim. Approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) is ₹16 Lakhs.
